objective.title: Qualify exact annotated Content and Presentation MathML subset

declared.summary: Qualify a bounded MathML 3 Content/Presentation exact IR interchange with canonical text and content annotations. Preserve rational, real-symbol, simple sum and original-equality structure; refuse ambiguous presentation, forged markup, DTD and XML budgets. Recover one compiled RED, pass 41 independent GREEN tests, eight isolated NuGet probes and three local package inspections. Complete only C03-T1; leave C03, W01 and M5 open.
declared.value: Let independent .NET Math consumers exchange exact, typed mathematical content and passive presentation with independently checked source identity rather than guessed visual equivalence.
debtChanges: Observe a genuine compiled missing MathML public API RED against the previously qualified codecs preview.4, before installing the new preview.5 implementation.
Introduce a pinned MathML 3 annotated profile with Content MathML integer rationals, real x/y/z, simple ordered sums and an original equality restriction, not a solved equation.
Bind passive Presentation MathML to both Math-owned canonical text and independent Content MathML annotations; never infer original math from unannotated display alone.
Import only canonical annotated XML using XmlReader with prohibited DTD, null resolver and tight size/node/depth bounds, refusing altered content, presentation or semantic annotations.

Remove remaining MSTEST0032 constant-vs-public-const Rule equality; assert RuleId on an actual Render result. Preserve all 41 GREEN oracles, with exact XML annotation, IR, namespace, tampering and budget tests.
Run locked .NET 10 Release solution build, the focused codecs suite and IR/quantities regressions; independently inspect three local net10 NuGet archives and their SHA-256.
Run eight standalone NuGet-only consumer oracles through one pinned codecs preview.5 reference with transitive IR/quantities, no project source dependency and no CAS/broker runtime.
Complete C03-T1 RED/GREEN/verification and T1 only. Activate C03; keep T2, C04, W01 and M5 uncompleted and leave public NuGet and stable 1.0 unclaimed.
